entities.name: O58320 glyoxylate reductase
observations: Exact sequence hash match to the 334-residue query protein; reviewed Pyrococcus horikoshii protein.
Annotated EC 1.1.1.26 glyoxylate reductase and NAD(P)H-dependent hydroxypyruvate reductase activities.
Pfam support: 2-Hacid_dh and 2-Hacid_dh_C domains, with NAD_binding_2 and F420_oxidored matches.

entities.name: Glycolate oxidation
observations: Rhea RHEA:18229: glycolate + NAD(+) = glyoxylate + NADH + H(+).
The reverse direction is glyoxylate reduction using NADH; related annotations also allow NADPH and hydroxypyruvate reduction activity.

entities.name: Glyoxylate reductase evidence
observations: Query length 334 aa and predicted molecular mass 37,999.7 Da.
Exact Swiss-Prot sequence match gives functional evidence substantially stronger than ordinary homology transfer.
